name: FixedPlantShutdownPlanner
tagline: Plan, ready and run a fixed plant shutdown – and see the handback forecast before it slips.
description: A complete shutdown planning app in one Power Apps code component: work packages by plant area, a CPM critical path forecast against the approved window, a readiness gate for parts, permits and contractors, daily progress entry and an overrun-risk list. Works on demo data the moment it is dropped; bind Items to your shutdown task table and map the columns.
features: CPM forecast and total float from the status date
Readiness gate and predecessor rule with reasoned override
On hold with delay reasons; reopen with reason
Daily progress capture for many tasks at once
SPI, % complete by earned hours, forecast handback and overrun hours
Bulk status, contractor, readiness and delete with confirmation
CSV export with forecast and float
Phone layout with bottom view bar
Power Fx outputs and events: OnSelect, OnChange, OnCreate, OnSave, OnAction, OnStatusChange
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
